notes.title: PTRL Stockcar Edition new Update 1.1
notes.notes:
New Content and Patch notes

 New Track "Concrete Beach X (Night/Day)"
 New Car "M80 X"
 Optimized Keyboard Controls
 Full Steam Deck support (Gamepad&Touchscreen)
 UI improvement
 Fixed minor Fog Issues
 New Sound for winning the Race
 if you want the full new experience you have to deinstall/reinstall the game. Caution! This will reset your progression
 for Multiplayer all Player need the same Version!
